ISS 3D model: NASA VTAD. 3D model display: NOT TO SCALE, enlarged and visually lifted in Earth View for readability. Position and altitude readouts remain physical. Visual orientation: trajectory-aligned; verified ISS attitude unavailable. NASA source.

The selected position source drives the model and Inspection camera. GP/TLE is computed with Orekit; NASA OEM is predicted ephemeris with bounded display interpolation. Both continuous trails start ahead of scene time and fade to zero over 85% of the primary mean-motion revolution, shortened honestly by OEM coverage. Neither product is onboard position telemetry or a ground truth claim. GP quality and CelesTrak acquisition remain independent of OEM availability. Earth imagery: NASA GIBS Blue Marble day imagery and historical Black Marble 2016 night lights.
